summary_hint: whose work authorization this is, the immigration document type and category, and the valid-from / expiration (admit-until) dates — so a processor can confirm the borrower is authorized to work and that authorization extends through closing without opening the card

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity — confirms the card genre

typed_core.name: immigration_document_type
typed_core.why: identity — EAD vs work visa vs I-94 vs permanent-resident card determines the auth framework (degraded from enum)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Card families: EAD (Form I-766), work visa (foil in passport), I-94 admission record, permanent-resident card (I-551) — this field routes the reading

typed_core.name: full_name
typed_core.why: identity — the authorized individual; attaches to the borrower (degraded from person)

typed_core.name: document_or_card_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) + identity — the card number

typed_core.name: uscis_or_a_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) — the Alien Registration Number; identity/linkage
typed_core.prompt_hint: A-number appears as 'A#', 'USCIS#', or 'Alien Reg. No.' with 8-9 digits — normalize into this field

typed_core.name: receipt_number
typed_core.why: PII (restricted) — USCIS receipt number; supports auto-extension eligibility checks

typed_core.name: date_of_birth
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) + identity — disambiguates individuals with the same name

typed_core.name: country_of_birth_or_citizenship
typed_core.why: processor — supports non-permanent-resident eligibility review

typed_core.name: visa_or_ead_category
typed_core.why: processor — the category/class (e.g. EAD C09, H-1B) determines the work-auth type
typed_core.prompt_hint: EAD category codes (e.g. C09, A05, C08) live on the front beside 'Category'; capture the code verbatim even when the human label (e.g. 'pending adjustment of status') is absent

typed_core.name: status_or_class_of_admission
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the admission class beside the category; the two together fix the exact status

typed_core.name: valid_from_date
typed_core.why: processor — when authorization begins

typed_core.name: expiration_or_admit_until_date
typed_core.why: processor — headline: does authorization extend through closing (continuance)
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'Duration of Status (D/S)' is a valid admit-until value and must NOT be forced into a date; capture the literal

typed_core.name: employer_or_petitioner_name
typed_core.why: processor — employer-specific status (e.g. H-1B) ties auth to a named employer

typed_core.name: employer_specific_restriction
typed_core.why: processor — restriction limiting work to a specific employer

typed_core.name: employment_authorized_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — headline authorized-to-work flag (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: automatic_extension_or_receipt_rule
typed_core.why: disambiguator — a 180-day auto-extension can make an 'expired' card still valid; needed beside the expiration date

typed_core.name: passport_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) — identity linkage to the passport

typed_core.name: passport_issuing_country
typed_core.why: processor — issuing country (degraded from country_code)

typed_core.name: visa_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) — the visa foil number; identity linkage

typed_core.name: i94_admission_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) — the I-94 admission number; identity/entry linkage

rejected.reason: the issuer is USCIS/DHS for every card; no discriminating value

rejected.name: form_number / form_revision_date
rejected.reason: the card form (I-766 etc.) is implied by immigration_document_type

rejected.name: party_names / party_addresses
rejected.reason: duplicate full_name; a card has no party address consumer

rejected.name: property_address / loan_number / account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not present on an ID card

rejected.name: sex
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL; no mortgage consumer and adds protected-class exposure

rejected.name: port_and_date_of_entry
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL object with no consumer; catch-all captures if needed

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block / document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: a card is not executed/notarized in this sense

encoding_variations: Expiration is stated as 'Card Expires', 'Valid Until', or 'Admit Until (D/S)' — where D/S ('duration of status') means no fixed date; capture that literal, do not coerce D/S to a date
EAD category codes (e.g. C09, A05, C08) are the machine-readable status; the human label ('pending adjustment of status') may be absent — capture the code into visa_or_ead_category

An expired card plus a valid receipt notice can still authorize work under the auto-extension rule — automatic_extension_or_receipt_rule must be captured beside the expiration to avoid a confident false 'expired' reading
A-number appears as 'A#', 'USCIS#', or 'Alien Reg. No.' with 8-9 digits — normalize into uscis_or_a_number

open_questions.q: Seven new _PII_FIELDS registrations. This one document nearly triples the current registry.
open_questions.recommendation: register all seven as listed; confirm the masking policy per field (last-4 vs raw+snapshot) with the security owner before build — flagging, not deciding GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: date_of_birth as PII + identity. DOB is highly_restricted but is the key disambiguator between same-named individuals.
options: keep typed, store raw, let the snapshot mask
open_questions.recommendation: keep typed, store raw, let the snapshot mask; do not drop it to the catch-all where it would be stored unmasked GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: 'D/S' and auto-extension handling. The expiration field can hold a non-date literal and an 'expired' card can still be valid.
options: keep expiration_or_admit_until_date permissive and co-capture automatic_extension_or_receipt_rule
open_questions.recommendation: keep expiration_or_admit_until_date as a permissive field and always co-capture automatic_extension_or_receipt_rule; a future work-authorization rule interprets the pair rather than a bare date comparison

notes: No rules read this document today (rule floor is empty). Fields are justified by identity, disambiguation, PII, and processor use.

This document type is unusually PII-dense: a government-issued identity card (EAD/visa/I-94), so most fields are restricted or highly_restricted and MUST be typed (the catch-all stores raw). Its mortgage value is establishing lawful work authorization and its expiration relative to closing.
None of the seven PII fields are in the 7-field _PII_FIELDS registry today; every one needs registration.
full_name is 'standard' sensitivity and typed for identity (not masked), consistent with names on other documents.
All identifier fields are sensitive — capture them but expect them to be masked; never emit a full number into the free-form catch-all.
